But min-height is a FLOOR not a ceiling -- when the async word-solver API resolves (a real network round trip, routinely >500ms) with a large result set (letters like common vowels can return hundreds of words, up to the 500-word cap, grouped into many length buckets), the box grows PAST 50vh and pushes the Quick Play CTA / How-To / Tips / FAQ sections further down the page -- and because that growth happens on data arrival rather than on the tap, it falls outside the input-exclusion window and IS counted as CLS. Updated the existing dedicated regression test (PageClient.layoutShift.test.tsx, asserts the class on the region) for the new fixed-height class, plus added a new case asserting a 500-word result set still keeps the fixed height + scroll instead of growing.
